summary: Iter 215eo - Companies House (UK) Public-Data API Proxy Testing Complete. Backend: 14/14 tests passed covering /status, /search, /company/{number} endpoints with auth gating, caching, field normalisation, and 404 handling. Frontend: All features verified - autocomplete shows two grouped sections (Existing organisations + Companies House UK), clicking CH suggestion pre-fills org_name, company_number, and full structured billing address (address_line1..3, city, county, postcode, country). VAT number correctly NOT pre-filled from CH.
seed_data_creation: None - used live Companies House API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 215eo Companies House integration fully tested. All three endpoints working: (1) GET /api/master-admin/companies-house/status returns enabled:true with base_url when API key is set, (2) GET /api/master-admin/companies-house/search?q=... returns normalised items with GymAxis field names (address_line1 not address_line_1, postcode not postal_code, city not locality), caches for 60s, (3) GET /api/master-admin/companies-house/company/{number} returns full profile with normalised address, caches for 15min, returns 404 for non-existent companies. Frontend HeadOfficeOnboardingWizard autocomplete shows two grouped sections with data-testid='ho-suggest-section-internal' and data-testid='ho-suggest-section-companies-house'. Clicking CH suggestion fetches full profile and pre-fills org_name, company_number, billing_address_line1..3, billing_city, billing_county, billing_postcode, billing_country. VAT number and phone are NOT pre-filled from CH (correct behaviour).
